# Compatibility

The pass rate of each test tier that exists today. `buoy-suites compat` writes this page and `docs/compat.json` from the committed summaries of the upstream suites, `tests/node/never.txt`, and the Buoy corpora, and `pnpm check` fails when either file differs from them. [docs/design/testing.md](design/testing.md) defines the tiers and the outcomes. The denominator of a rate is every test, skips included. A silent failure is `fail`, `timeout`, or `harness_error`: the program ran and gave a wrong result.

### Blockers

A blocker is a diagnostic code, a built-in that throws a late rejection, or a harness file that does not compile. The table counts the tests that each one blocks and the tests where it is the only blocker, and it sorts by the second count.

| Blocker | Tests blocked | Only blocker |
| --- | --- | --- |

## Node native bindings

Buoy implements 389 of the 895 members that src/ of Node sets on its 70 `internalBinding` objects (43.5%). `cargo run --release -p buoy-suites -- node-bindings` reads them from Node's source into `tests/node/bindings.json`. A member counts when the module of its binding names it and passes it to no stub helper, so a module that builds its names, such as the accessors of `report`, counts low. Each function and class that a binding lacks throws `ERR_BUOY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED` with its name.

The test of each corpus fails when a program breaks its rule, so these counts hold on every commit that passes `pnpm check`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| conformance | 72 | pass 72 | each program prints what Node printed | `crates/buoy-cli/tests/conformance.rs` |
| equivalence/effect | 23 | pass 23 | each program prints what Node printed | `crates/buoy-cli/tests/equivalence.rs` |
| equivalence/ai | 7 | pass 7 | each program prints what Node printed | `crates/buoy-cli/tests/ai.rs` |
| programs | 35 | pass 35 | each test checks the contract | `crates/buoy-cli/tests/programs.rs` |
| npm | 19 | rejected 19 | each program has the outcome of `tests/npm/expectations.txt` | `crates/buoy-cli/tests/ecosystem.rs` |

The `fuzz` row counts the open fuzz cases: a case that is not `pass` is open. `tests/unit` and `tests/divergence` do not exist yet, so the page has no `buoy test` row and no open count of the divergence register.
